name: Cinolazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine derivative drug with anxiolytic effects but mainly hypnotic effects. It is extremely effective as a sleep aid but has mild euphoria compared to other benzodiazepines.
advisory: Caution: Do not mix with any CNS depressants. The combination can prove to be fatal and also increases likelihood of blacking out.
